title: Architecture and design
learning_outcomes: Explain form and function in the context of architecture and design.
Compare and distinguish materials and circulation in the context of architecture and design.
Apply accessibility in the context of architecture and design.
Evaluate and justify decisions about design response in the context of architecture and design.

lessons.title: Form and function
lessons.outcome: Explain form and function in the context of architecture and design.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving form and function; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to annotated spatial concept.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain form and function from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of form and function; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Materials and circulation
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish materials and circulation in the context of architecture and design.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving materials and circulation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to annotated spatial concept.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain materials and circulation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of materials and circulation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Accessibility
lessons.outcome: Apply accessibility in the context of architecture and design.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving accessibility; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to annotated spatial concept.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain accessibility from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of accessibility; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Design response
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about design response in the context of architecture and design.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving design response; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to annotated spatial concept.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain design response from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of design response; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of form and function; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of materials and circulation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of accessibility; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of design response; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Practising artist or arts educator; cultural expertise where relevant.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
